result.description: MANN BRICKLAYING PTY LTD  MANN BRICKLAYING PTY LTD is seeking an experienced and dedicated Bricklayer to join our growing team. This position offers the opportunity to work on a diverse range of construction projects where precision, craftsmanship and attention to detail are highly valued. The successful applicant will contribute to the construction, repair and restoration of masonry structures while working within a professional and supportive environment.   Benefits   Competitive salary of $75,000–$90,000 plus superannuation.  Secure, full-time permanent employment.  Opportunity to work on a variety of residential, commercial and civil construction projects.  Supportive and experienced team environment.  Ongoing training and opportunities for career progression.  Modern equipment, quality materials and a strong safety culture.  Stable employment with a reputable and growing company.  Recognition and reward for reliability, commitment and quality workmanship.    Task & responsibilities   Study construction drawings, plans and project specifications to determine material requirements, dimensions and appropriate bricklaying methods.  Prepare work areas by sealing foundations with damp-proof materials and applying mortar beds to support masonry construction.  Measure, cut and shape bricks, concrete blocks, stone and other masonry materials using hand and power tools to achieve accurate fitting.  Set out and construct brick, block and stonework for walls, partitions, arches, columns, paving and other structural elements.  Lay bricks, blocks and other masonry units in mortar while ensuring structures remain level, plumb, aligned and finished to a high standard.  Install lintels, flashings and other structural components around openings in accordance with construction requirements.  Erect and dismantle restricted-height scaffolding safely where required for construction activities.  Carry out repairs, restoration and maintenance of brickwork, blockwork and related masonry structures.  Prepare base layers and bedding courses and install segmental paving where required.  Ensure all work complies with Australian building standards, project specifications and workplace health and safety requirements.  Maintain tools, equipment and work areas in a safe, clean and organised condition.  Collaborate effectively with supervisors, site managers and other trades to ensure projects are completed efficiently and on schedule.    Qualification & experience   1–3 years of relevant bricklaying experience is essential.  A completed relevant qualification in Bricklaying, Masonry or an equivalent trade qualification is required.  Ability to interpret construction drawings, plans and technical specifications.  Strong knowledge of bricklaying techniques, masonry materials and Australian building standards.  Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality workmanship.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.  Good communication and organisational skills.  Commitment to workplace health and safety practices.  Registration or licensing may be required where applicable.   About Company    MANN BRICKLAYING PTY LTD is a trusted Victorian construction company specialising in high-quality bricklaying and masonry services for residential, commercial and civil projects. We are committed to delivering exceptional workmanship, maintaining strong safety standards, and exceeding client expectations. Our success is built on skilled tradespeople, teamwork and a commitment to quality, making us an excellent place to develop a long-term career.
